question: Do the declared data B, the positive principal half-density D^(-1/2), the target Hilbert representation H_D and its self-adjoint multiplication constraint M_c uniquely determine an exact normalized endpoint-state completion within that declared data class?

upstream_results.role: fixes B through W, the canonical relation and principal half-density while killing exact unitarity of the uncorrected one-term kernel
supplies only the declared target L2(dc dp) representation and self-adjoint M_c domain

primary_sources.source: Henneaux, Teitelboim and Vergara, Gauge invariance for generally covariant systems, arXiv:hep-th/9205092
primary_sources.used_for: the requirement to transform endpoint actions and endpoint state data consistently
primary_sources.not_used_for: selecting an exact full symbol or proving uniqueness of a quantum endpoint transform

primary_sources.source: Hormander, Fourier integral operators. I, Acta Math. 127 (1971) 79
primary_sources.used_for: the separation of canonical relation and principal symbol from lower-order symbol data

conditional_family.hypothesis: suppose at least one exact unitary completion U_0 from a chosen old endpoint Hilbert space to H_D exists
conditional_family.target_unitary: V_kappa,hbar=exp(i*hbar*kappa*c) acting by multiplication on H_D
conditional_family.constraint_relation: V_kappa commutes strongly with M_c and preserves D(M_c)
conditional_family.shell_relation: V_kappa(0,p)=1, so the declared order-zero delta(M_c) pairing is unchanged

exact_plan: hash-verify the principal FIO and local spectral-domain inputs
verify V_kappa has unit modulus, is exactly unitary on L2(dc dp), commutes with M_c and preserves its maximal domain
verify postcomposition preserves exact unitarity conditional on any U_0
verify the added action is O(hbar^2), the canonical relation and B are unchanged at classical order, and the principal half-density is unchanged while the subprincipal coefficient shifts
verify the family is nontrivial on one normalized Gaussian-half-line test state
verify V_kappa equals one on c=0, so a later delta(M_c) pairing cannot choose kappa
retain the prior coarea KILL for the uncorrected one-term kernel and keep exact-transform existence open

numerical_plan.quadrature: direct c-line Gaussian characteristic-function integration; the normalized p>0 factor integrates exactly to one

decision_table.condition: the conditional unitary family preserves the classical B, canonical relation, principal half-density and M_c domain but changes a lower symbol and a finite-hbar test state
decision_table.meaning: B, D^(-1/2), H_D and M_c cannot select a unique completion inside the class that fixes only those data; extra exact intertwining or endpoint conditions may restrict the family, and existence remains open

decision_table.condition: the proposed family is not unitary, changes the principal data, or is identical on every test state
decision_table.meaning: this discriminator does not settle whether the supplied data determine a completion

computed_scope: one exact target-unitary subprincipal family conditional on any exact endpoint completion
preservation of the local constraint domain and zero spectral fiber
a closed-form and high-precision witness that finite-hbar operators differ
not_computed: existence or construction of U_0 or any exact endpoint-state transform
full-symbol transport equations, exact old-variable intertwining, edge conditions or global Maslov gluing
a coordinate-polarization kernel, old fixed-a kernel equivalence, BFV trajectory measure or full-real-lapse group average
a physical endpoint state, physical cycle, physics claim or TOE claim
